checks.name: keyboard: neutral, opposing directions, crouch and both facings match combat
pointers: neutral, opposing directions, crouch and both facings match combat
standard-gamepad: neutral, opposing directions, crouch and both facings match combat
Opposed directions across keyboard, pointer and gamepad resolve neutrally
Releasing one opposite direction restores the surviving direction and respects a facing change
Repeated keydowns cannot repeat a special, and clear removes pending actions and held sources
Guard, throw escape, jump and dash retain their original action semantics

scope: Real trial-input and combat direction resolver in Node VM. Device events are fixtures; physical controllers and a full browser match are separate checks.
